name: Tachibana Yuzu
source: Withdrawn from school due to an illness, Yuzu is now being tutored by Takayuki. Due to being so small and weak, Yuzu spends most studying time on the bed and only wears pajamas. Seems very much like a girl, but has a certain something that girls don't usually have.
translation: Withdrawn from school due to an illness, Yuzu is now being tutored by Takayuki. Due to being so small and weak, Yuzu spends most studying time on the bed and only wears pajamas. Seems very much like a girl, but has a certain something that girls don't usually have.
